name: protein phosphatase, Mg2+/Mn2+ dependent 1D
pathways: regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PPM1D encodes protein phosphatase 1D. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. It participates in regulation of intracellular signal transduction and regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder with gastrointestinal difficulties and high pain threshold (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
